title: tc-artifact-panel
description: The files, code and documents a run produced: a list, a preview per type, versions with a diff, download.

selected.description: The id of the artifact shown; empty shows the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

version.description: The id of the version shown; empty shows the latest. Changed by the user unless a tc-version-change listener calls preventDefault()

view.description: "preview", or "diff" to compare the version with the one before. Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

emptyLabel.description: Shown when there is nothing yet

previewHeight.description: The preview's height cap in px; longer content scrolls

name.description: File name, e.g. "launch-plan.md" – also the download name

language.description: Code: the language for the colours (ts, py, json, html, css, sh …)

mimeType.description: The download's media type; a sensible one by kind when left out

status.description: "writing" while the run is still producing it: the newest version streams

label.description: Chip text; defaults to v1, v2 …

time.description: When, ready to show: "2 min ago"

note.description: What changed in this version: "Tightened the intro"

content.description: Text or code; an image URL; a table (or CSV text)
